lastCompletedStory.title: Deterministic post-merge invocable (pull origin main + tag-on-main + prune local/remote)

nextStoryContext: US-006 added src/release/post-merge.ts: runPostMerge(opts) with injectable SpawnFn and ReadVersionFileFn. Steps: (1) git pull origin main, (2) read version from src/version.ts on disk after pull (not CAM_VERSION binary constant), (3) idempotent tag vX.Y.Z (tag -l check, then tag + push if absent), (4) best-effort branch prune local and remote. Returns PostMergeOutcome = { ok: true; pulledSha, tag, tagCreated, branchPrunedLocal, branchPrunedRemote } | { ok: false; reason }. No journal writes. 15 tests all pass. US-007 will wire this into the sidecar merge-watch path (poll gh pr view, on MERGED call runPostMerge, narrate via notifyOrchestrator).
